authorized_to_draft_by: PI. EXPLICITLY NOT AUTHORIZED TO LAUNCH -- no training step, no seed reservation, and no code change may occur until the PI releases this spec.
THE_QUESTION: Would the sealed B3-3 specialists recover 4v4 specialization after another fresh 1,000,000 PPO steps WITHOUT informative entity geometry?

chain: the 4v4 entity-repair run produced delta_A=+0.352 (pass) / delta_B=-0.086 (fail) -- asymmetric recovery

POLE_B_ENTITY_UTILIZATION: the entity pathway has a small per-decision footprint (~4% of input norm, ~97% greedy-action agreement when deleted) and that footprint is SYMMETRIC between the passing and failing regimes

POLE_A_GEOMETRY_ABLATION: closed-loop, C_A = -0.078 [-0.266, +0.109]; delta_A SURVIVES total geometry deletion (delta_A_zero=+0.359). H1 is operationally rejected as the load-bearing explanation at inference

what remains: H2 geometry-as-training-scaffold (the pathway shaped the optimization trajectory, then became redundant) vs H3 training-duration (the extra 1,000,000 steps would have done it with or without geometry). Neither can be tested on an already-trained checkpoint. This experiment is the only way to separate them.

CONTROL_CONSTRUCTION.principle: isolate the INFORMATION, not the architecture. The control must differ from the treatment in exactly one respect: the entity tensors carry no information. Everything else -- module, parameter count, optimizer param groups, buffer fields, code path, warm-start semantics -- is bit-for-bit the same machinery.
CONTROL_CONSTRUCTION.mechanism: keep entity_repair_enabled=True (same augmented architecture and plumbing) and ZERO the entity FEATURE tensors (teammates, enemies) at every step of training. Validity masks are left untouched.
CONTROL_CONSTRUCTION.why_not_entity_repair_enabled_false: that would change the architecture, the parameter count, the optimizer param groups and the rollout-buffer field set simultaneously with the information content -- four confounds instead of one. A difference found under that design could not be attributed to geometry.
CONTROL_CONSTRUCTION.why_zeroing_is_an_exact_information_dele: EntityResidualEncoder is bias-free throughout, so 0 in -> 0 out at every linear/ReLU, and the masked mean pool of all-zero encodings is exactly zero. Therefore g == 0 EXACTLY at every forward pass, for any weights, at any point in training. This is already proven in tests/test_entity_residual.py and re-asserted live by contract C2 below.

DERIVED_PREDICTION_that_must_be_verified.claim: the control's entity_encoder parameters will remain EXACTLY at their initialization for the entire 1,000,000 steps.
DERIVED_PREDICTION_that_must_be_verified.derivation: g = W_proj @ concat(t_pooled, e_pooled). With zeroed features, concat(...) == 0, so dL/dW_proj = (dL/dg) (x)^T = 0. W_proj is zero-initialised, so dL/dx = W_proj^T (dL/dg) = 0, hence the per-entity encoders receive zero gradient too. With zero gradient and (expected) zero weight decay, Adam's update is identically zero.
DERIVED_PREDICTION_that_must_be_verified.why_it_must_be_CHECKED: if the shared optimizer carries nonzero weight_decay, parameters WOULD drift under zero gradient, which would be a real (if small) difference from the treatment. Contract C5 checks this empirically rather than trusting this derivation.
DERIVED_PREDICTION_that_must_be_verified.if_the_check_fails: do not launch. Report the weight-decay discrepancy and re-specify.

implementation_required_before_launch.seam: the single place entity tensors are created for the rollout path -- gpu_env/_core/_entity_obs.py::augment_obs_with_entities gains a zero_features flag, and rl/custom_ppo/rollout/collector.py passes cfg.entity_repair_zero_ablation at BOTH of its call sites (collect() and _step_once()). Zeroing at the creation seam rather than duplicating it at each call site keeps one auditable location.
implementation_required_before_launch.preset_snapshot: tests/preset_snapshots.json must be regenerated and the diff reviewed (expected: exactly one new key, zero value changes) -- the same procedure already used for entity_repair_enabled, entity_hidden_dim and warm_start_reset_progress
implementation_required_before_launch.status: NOT YET WRITTEN. Code is deliberately not authored until this spec is released, so the spec cannot be shaped by the implementation.

TRAINING_MATCHING.budget: exactly 1,000,000 fresh steps per policy -- identical to the treatment

training_seeds.rationale: DELIBERATE TREATMENT-CONTROL MATCHING. Reusing the treatment's training seeds makes the environment/initialisation random streams common to both conditions, so the D contrast isolates the geometry manipulation instead of also absorbing a different random draw. This is matched-pair design, NOT evaluation-seed reuse: no training seed is ever used for evaluation.
training_seeds.registry_handling: must be registered via experiments/seed_registry.py::allocate with subdivides='4V4_ENTITY_REPAIR_TRAINING', which is the registry's sanctioned mechanism for declared, deliberate sharing with a parent block. Silently re-spending 17700001-2 without that declaration is forbidden and would be caught by check_block as an overlap.
training_seeds.reproducibility_caveat: seed equality makes the two runs' streams comparable at construction. It does NOT guarantee identical trajectories -- the policies diverge as soon as the (different) actions differ, and CUDA nondeterminism may contribute. Matching removes a nuisance source of variance; it does not make the runs paired step-for-step, and no such claim will be made.

EVALUATION_DESIGN.principle: the treatment pair is RE-EVALUATED on the same fresh block as the control pair. The primary contrast is never computed against the old sealed +0.352 from a different seed block.

TREATMENT_CONSISTENT_EVALUATION_do_not_g.rule: each policy is evaluated under the SAME entity condition it was trained under. The entity pair sees real geometry; the control pair sees ZEROED geometry.
TREATMENT_CONSISTENT_EVALUATION_do_not_g.why: evaluating the control with real entity tensors would present it with an input distribution it never encountered in training -- a distribution shift that has nothing to do with the hypothesis under test.
TREATMENT_CONSISTENT_EVALUATION_do_not_g.does_this_confound_D_A: no, and this is precisely why POLE_A_GEOMETRY_ABLATION had to run first. That experiment established C_A = -0.078 [-0.266, +0.109]: the evaluation-time entity condition does not detectably move delta_A. With the evaluation-time factor shown to be immaterial, D_A isolates the TRAINING-time manipulation. Had the ablation come back with C_A large, this design would have been uninterpretable and the spec would have needed a 2x2 evaluation instead.

seeds.block: one FRESH block, class sealed_confirmatory, n=128, to be reserved via seed_registry.py IMMEDIATELY BEFORE LAUNCH and not before -- per the standing rule that seed reservation is the last administrative action.
seeds.pole_B_uses: the FIRST 64 seeds of the same block (exploratory secondary question) -- declared now, in advance, so the subset is not chosen after seeing any result
seeds.disjointness: must not overlap 16700001-16700128 (sealed B3-3 crossover), 17700001-17700002 (training), 17800001-17800192 (entity crossover eval), 17900001-17900128 (POLE_B_ENTITY_DIAGNOSIS), 18000001-18000064 (POLE_A_GEOMETRY_ABLATION)

EVALUATION_DESIGN.total_episodes: 4 cells x 128 (Pole A) + 4 cells x 64 (Pole B) = 768

ESTIMANDS.D_A: delta_A_ENTITY - delta_A_CONTROL     <-- PRIMARY, H2 vs H3
ESTIMANDS.D_B: delta_B_ENTITY - delta_B_CONTROL     <-- EXPLORATORY, bears on the remaining Pole-B problem
ESTIMANDS.bootstrap: every quantity is a SEED-LEVEL PAIRED contrast, resampled over seeds with a SINGLE shared resample matrix across all estimands, so they are mutually consistent. Never computed by differencing independently bootstrapped win rates.
ESTIMANDS.also_reported: all eight raw cell win rates, and the realized correlation between the paired series entering each D, as a pairing-efficiency diagnostic

PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.condition: the no-geometry control pair reproduces strong Pole-A specialization (delta_A_CONTROL comparable to delta_A_ENTITY; D_A near zero)
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.reading: H3 is SUFFICIENT. The extra 1,000,000 steps explain the recovery; geometry-as-scaffold is not needed to account for Pole A.
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.next: the entity repair is not the active ingredient. The Pole-B problem becomes 'B needs more or better-targeted ACQUISITION time', not another representation redesign -- a much cheaper class of fix.

PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.condition: delta_A_CONTROL does NOT recover (stays near the original sealed pre-repair +0.047) while delta_A_ENTITY does, on the matched fresh block (D_A clearly positive)
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.reading: H2 gains DIRECT support. Training WITH the entity pathway present mattered, even though the trained policy barely uses it at inference -- a genuine scaffold effect.
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.next: the repair is real but acts during learning. Investigate what the scaffold provides (gradient shaping? exploration? credit assignment?) and whether it can be delivered more directly to Pole B.

PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.condition: both conditions unstable or mutually inconsistent (e.g. delta_A_ENTITY fails to reproduce on the fresh block, or telemetry shows unhealthy training in either control run)
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.reading: neither mechanism gets credited. This is a robustness failure, not evidence.
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION_frozen_befor.next: STOP and diagnose robustness first. Do not interpret D_A causally. The single-training-seed limitation below is the leading suspect and replication is the remedy.

KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTRACTS_before_the_real_r.C1_initialisation_identity: at step 0, the control model's parameters are bit-identical to the treatment model's parameters when both are warm-started from the same sealed B3-3 checkpoint under the same seed -- including the freshly-initialised entity_encoder. Verified by direct state-dict comparison, not asserted.
KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTRACTS_before_the_real_r.C2_zero_residual_through_the_REAL_path: during an actual collect_rollout() + update() cycle with entity_repair_zero_ablation=True, the entity residual g is EXACTLY zero at every forward pass. Checked by (a) asserting the rollout buffer's obs_teammates / obs_enemies fields are all-zero, and (b) evaluating entity_encoder on the collected batch and asserting torch.equal against zeros. Both, not either.
KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTRACTS_before_the_real_r.C3_base_observation_untouched: grid / vec / agent_mask / mask collected under entity_repair_zero_ablation=True are bit-identical to those collected without it from the same env state. The ablation must delete information from the entity stream only.
KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTRACTS_before_the_real_r.C4_behavioural_equivalence_at_warm_start: the control's step-0 policy logits equal the sealed B3-3 checkpoint's logits exactly (the existing compat-loader behavioural-equivalence check must print PASS with max_logit_diff=0), confirming the control starts from the same behaviour as the treatment did.
KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTRACTS_before_the_real_r.C5_entity_encoder_parameters_frozen: after a short real PPO smoke with the ablation active, entity_encoder parameters are bit-identical to their initialisation -- empirically confirming the zero-gradient derivation above and ruling out weight-decay drift.
KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTRACTS_before_the_real_r.C6_the_flag_actually_changes_something: with the flag OFF on the same env state, the collected entity tensors are NOT all-zero. Guards against a vacuous control in which the ablation silently failed to engage and the run is quietly a second treatment replicate.
KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTRACTS_before_the_real_r.gate: every contract must pass before the first training step. Any failure blocks launch.

single_training_seed_per_condition.issue: one control run per pole means D_A is a PAIRED SINGLE-REPLICATE contrast. It cannot statistically separate a geometry effect from training-seed-to-training-seed variance, which is large in RL generally and has bitten this project before (a prior 3-seed run had 2/3 seeds collapse to a degenerate policy).
single_training_seed_per_condition.what_the_design_CAN_do: screen a LARGE effect. Branch 1 and branch 2 are far apart (delta_A_CONTROL ~ +0.30 vs ~ +0.05); a single seed per condition can distinguish 'recovered' from 'did not recover' at that separation.
single_training_seed_per_condition.what_the_design_CANNOT_do: deliver a calibrated effect size, or exclude that this particular seed was lucky or unlucky. This is a SCREENING experiment.
single_training_seed_per_condition.consequence_frozen_now: no result from this experiment may be called confirmatory. If the outcome is used to support a claim in a write-up, it must first be replicated at >= 3 training seeds per condition, which would cost roughly 3x the training budget here.
single_training_seed_per_condition.precommitted_trigger_for_replication: if D_A's interval includes zero AND delta_A_CONTROL lands between the two branch anchors (roughly 0.10-0.25), the result is ambiguous and replication at additional training seeds is required before any reading is taken.
